GB.text: There is no current British national identity card in this catalog: the former program was cancelled. This does not mean other identification credentials do not exist.

IE.text: Does not issue a national ID card. The passport card is shown separately; the Public Services Card is a different category.

DK.text: A municipal identification card (Legitimationskort) exists; its image has not been obtained. It is not equivalent to the national travel ID.

AU.text: State cards exist, such as the NSW Photo Card. A variant and its two sides still need to be added; it is not presented as a single national DNI.

CA.text: Provincial cards exist, such as the Ontario Photo Card. A variant and its two sides still need to be added.

US.text: State IDs exist, such as the California DMV card. A variant and its two sides still need to be added; it is not confused with the passport card.

RU.text: The internal identification is listed in the inventory as a booklet passport. That image is missing; it is not interpreted as a card-format ID with front/back.
